full_judgment: 3. The petitioner on 23-5-2006 replied to the notice of show cause denying the allegations and stated that it had legally accepted the money against duty draw back from the respondent No. 3. The respondent No. 3 raised the audit objection on the basis of surmise and presumption and, as such, it is not tenable in the eye of law. The respondent No. 3 did not disclose the reasons on the basis of which the demand was made and most illegally passed the order under Nothi No. 05 /DEDO/5111- 0001-44/2004/063/2961 dated 22-6-2006 directing the petitioner to pay Taka 12,41,429 under Section 55 of the Value Added Tax Act, 1991.
